questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with South Africa?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter B and has 8 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the South Africa article.

questions.proof: South Africa is next to Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, and Eswatini, but encloses Lesotho.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of South Africa?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter E and has 7 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Society and culture” part of the South Africa article.

questions.proof: Urban blacks normally speak English or Afrikaans in addition to their native tongue.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In 1795, Great Britain took the Cape from the Dutch East _____ Company, to stop France from taking it.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter I and has 5 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the South Africa article.

questions.proof: In 1795, Great Britain took the Cape from the Dutch East India Company, to stop France from taking it.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “At 1,219,912 square kilometres (471,011 square miles), South Africa is the 25th-largest country in the world and is almost the size of _____.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter C and has 8 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the South Africa article.

questions.proof: At 1,219,912 square kilometres (471,011 square miles), South Africa is the 25th-largest country in the world and is almost the size of Colombia.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The king of _____ changed it to "Cape of Good Hope".”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter P and has 8 letters.
